name: focus-app
description: FocusFlow — full-stack task & focus tracker (NestJS + Next.js)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend --if-present && npm run lint -w backend --if-present
